title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2610.00202v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. translated_title: 当数据伪影并非捷径时：对合成RLVR语料库的因果审计
translated_abstract: 近期一些数据构建流程通过遮蔽真实语料文本中的一个片段，并让语言模型围绕它编造貌似合理的错误答案来构建RLVR训练数据。因此，正确选项是真实的人类文本，而每个干扰项都是合成的。正确性与数据来源由此纠缠在一起，策略模型原则上可能学到后者而非前者。我们在GooseReason-0.7M中审计了这种可能性。首先我们探究这种不对称性是否可见：一个仅读取五个表面统计特征（从不读取语义）的分类器在315,499个选项上仅达到0.562的AUROC，几乎不高于随机水平。然而总体数据掩盖了一些情况：代码类别的AUROC仅为0.416，低于随机水平，人工检查解释了原因——代码干扰项实际上是对标准答案进行单算子变异生成的，而非自由撰写的替代答案，因此两类样本在构造上几乎完全相同。检测到信号并不等于证明模型确实使用了该信号，因此我们……
tldr: 该研究对合成RLVR语料库GooseReason-0.7M进行因果审计，发现人类撰写的正确选项与合成干扰项之间的来源不对称性从表面统计特征上几乎不可检测（AUROC仅0.562，代码类别甚至低于随机水平），表明模型不太可能将数据来源当作捷径来学习而非真正学会正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper causally audits the synthetic RLVR corpus GooseReason-0.7M and finds that the provenance asymmetry between human-written correct options and synthetic distractors is barely detectable from surface statistics (AUROC 0.562, below chance for code), suggesting models are unlikely to exploit data origin as a shortcut instead of learning correctness.
